pattern: Refresh an installed T3 plugin from a prepared directory
experience: An agent needs a supported MCP operation to apply an installed plugin's replacement files.

setup.context: You are a full-access T3 Code agent. The user has already prepared the replacement plugin directory on this environment.

prompt: Update the installed T3 Code plugin com.example.board using the prepared files at /home/user/plugins/board.

source.note: T3 Code MCP plugin update feature request

pattern: Install a T3 plugin from an approved prepared directory
experience: An agent needs a supported MCP operation to install plugin files the user prepared.

setup.context: You are a full-access T3 Code agent. The user has already prepared the replacement plugin directory on this environment.

prompt: Install the T3 Code plugin from the prepared folder /home/user/plugins/board.

source.note: T3 Code MCP plugin update feature request
